name: external6.k
model:
class CEGARTest {
  x:Real
  y:Real
  z:Real

  req x > 0E0

  req x < 1E2

  req y = java.lang.Math.sqrt(x)

  req z = y * y

  req z > x - 1E-3

  req z < x + 1E-3
}

test:CEGARTest
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (test Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((CEGARTest (mk-CEGARTest (x Real)(y Real)(z Real)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-CEGARTest (sel-CEGARTest CEGARTest))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-CEGARTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-CEGARTest (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-CEGARTest ((this Ref)) CEGARTest
  (sel-CEGARTest (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-CEGARTest ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-CEGARTest this)
)

; =======================================
; === External Function Declarations: ===
; =======================================

; Uninterpreted functions for external (Java) calls
(declare-fun java_lang_Math_sqrt (Real) Real)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.test: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!test ((this Ref)) Ref
  (test (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --------------------------------
;   Getters for class CEGARTest:
; --------------------------------

; --- getters for CEGARTest.x: ---

(define-fun CEGARTest!x ((this Ref)) Real
  (x (deref-CEGARTest this))
)

; --- getters for CEGARTest.y: ---

(define-fun CEGARTest!y ((this Ref)) Real
  (y (deref-CEGARTest this))
)

; --- getters for CEGARTest.z: ---

(define-fun CEGARTest!z ((this Ref)) Real
  (z (deref-CEGARTest this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-CEGARTest (TopLevelDeclarations!test this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))



; ----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class CEGARTest:
; ----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-CEGARTest CEGARTest)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun CEGARTest.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (CEGARTest!x this) 0.0000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (CEGARTest.inv1 1) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun CEGARTest.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (< (CEGARTest!x this) 100.0000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (CEGARTest.inv2 1) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun CEGARTest.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (CEGARTest!y this) (java_lang_Math_sqrt (CEGARTest!x this)))
)

(assert (! (CEGARTest.inv3 1) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun CEGARTest.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (CEGARTest!z this) (* (CEGARTest!y this) (CEGARTest!y this)))
)

(assert (! (CEGARTest.inv4 1) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun CEGARTest.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (CEGARTest!z this) (- (CEGARTest!x this) 0.0010000000000000))
)

(assert (! (CEGARTest.inv5 1) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun CEGARTest.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (< (CEGARTest!z this) (+ (CEGARTest!x this) 0.0010000000000000))
)

(assert (! (CEGARTest.inv6 1) :named _xkassert6))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-CEGARTest const-1-CEGARTest))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-CEGARTest () CEGARTest
  (mk-CEGARTest (/ 1.0 2000.0) 0.0 0.0))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (< (x (sel-CEGARTest (select heap 1))) 100.0))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (java_lang_Math_sqrt (x (sel-CEGARTest (select heap 1))))))
  (= (y (sel-CEGARTest (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (- (x (sel-CEGARTest (select heap 1))) (/ 1.0 1000.0))))
  (> (z (sel-CEGARTest (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (test (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-CEGARTest a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (x (sel-CEGARTest (select heap 1))) (/ 1.0 1000.0))))
  (< (z (sel-CEGARTest (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (> (x (sel-CEGARTest (select heap 1))) 0.0))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (* (y (sel-CEGARTest (select heap 1)))
              (y (sel-CEGARTest (select heap 1))))))
  (= (z (sel-CEGARTest (select heap 1))) a!1)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
              0
              (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 1)))
       1
       (lift-CEGARTest (mk-CEGARTest (/ 1.0 2000.0) 0.0 0.0))))
(define-fun java_lang_Math_sqrt ((x!0 Real)) Real
  0.0)
